scope: exact finite graph/partition mathematical checks and Std-only origin audit toy gates; no complete ordinary solver
tree_encoding: integer leaf or length-two JSON array; children unordered for restricted shape; graph addresses retain original child indices

cases.budgets: minimum-1,minimum,minimum+1 independently enumerated; not pinned to selector order

ordinary_table.key: crossed quartet target versus balanced source

origin_controls.stdlib_only: import Lean is auditor tooling; scientific toy modules import Std only
origin_controls.clean: complete all-origin inventory, no custom axioms, all private/generated origins present
origin_controls.unused_axiom: custom axiom absent from queried theorem dependency closure must still be rejected
origin_controls.private_axiom: private custom axiom must be inventoried and rejected
origin_controls.false_theorem: False by decide must fail compilation
origin_controls.private_generated: recursive matcher/private producer declarations must be inventoried even if not queried
origin_controls.missing_origin: remove one record -> fail exact origin-set gate
origin_controls.duplicate_origin: repeat one record -> fail uniqueness gate
origin_controls.import_adapter: module import spelling only changed -> exact type/body records agree modulo declared private-name module prefix renaming
origin_controls.body_adapter: public type same but body altered -> fail body equality gate
origin_controls.all_origins: environment module-origin filter; not namespace prefix, query closure or queried theorem only

pilot.graph: known/corrupted plant first, then 4-label crossed and 5-label sole-hard per-case timing
pilot.lean: one clean Std scientific toy and all-origin auditor first
pilot.standing_rule: unexpected failure retained; no threshold drift; larger census requires measured projection
